selection_note: Encoder: fine-tuned all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (best on Wikipedia val and Stack Exchange ext_dev, smallest, fastest). Head: flat subtopic softmax (won E-7 on val and ext_dev for every encoder). OOD threshold calibrated on real questions (E-9). min_confidence: largest grid value keeping >= 90% of ext_dev questions answered. Language gate: fastText lid.176 + lexicon, per-length reject confidence chosen on dev (D-30). See decisions.md D-22..D-29 and docs/MODEL_REPORT.md.
